proposed.text: For essential communications equipment in a seismic design scenario, what does the checked NSCP source support?

options.text: It is excluded from nonstructural component categories.
It appears in Table 208-13 with related equipment anchorage and support-system treatment.
It is governed only by flood provisions.
It needs no anchorage if located indoors.

rationale.takeaway: Essential communications equipment stays within the Table 208-13 equipment-category anchor.
